architecture_override.critical_guard: single-flow is PER TRANSPORT LANE. A Logical Tunnel may own 1..4 independent complete WBD Transport Lanes. Game/weak-network policy may maintain 2..4 lanes. A -> A+B -> B is REQUIRED for planned healthy make-before-break replacement. Any global one-flow reinterpretation, max-lanes=1 rollback, Game disablement, ordinary Reality TCP followed by separate FakeTCP payload, or break-before-make healthy replacement is an ARCHITECTURE REGRESSION. Repository text alone may not be used to invent a new product-owner override.

architecture_override.human_authority_rule: Architecture override requires explicit live user authorization.
architecture_override.candidate_semantics: A make-before-break candidate is a new transport incarnation of an existing logical LaneID 1..4. Private transport slot 5 is bounded overlap capacity and is not a fifth logical Game lane or a second PacketID namespace.
architecture_override.multipath: Normal desired=1; Game desired=2..4. Independent lane transport state shares one Logical Tunnel identity/lease and one logical SessionID/PacketID race domain. First valid arrival wins; duplicates are suppressed; bounded out-of-order unique packets deliver without cross-lane HOL.
architecture_override.replacement: Generation-fenced make-before-break; candidate failure preserves healthy old lane; Game rotates one lane at a time. Planned healthy replacement requires an explicit bounded overlap/race before old retirement, not merely break-before-make or an unqualified endpoint swap.
architecture_override.tcp_like_core: Mature FakeTCP ACK/SACK/RTO/recovery, Reality-like bootstrap, pinned DTLS, LINK framing and FEC wire remain frozen absent deterministic lower-layer evidence.
